rubric.instructions: Review two independent real-paper holdout decks generated by the normal research-presentations production entrypoint. Inspect every substantive page and each deck contact sheet. For the statistics deck, require brms-specific Bayesian multilevel/Stan notation, worked-example evidence, package comparison, and limitations rather than Stage 4 fixture content. For the medical deck, require real MedSAM article medical-image segmentation evidence, preserved prompt/annotation/prediction semantics, exact CUHK identity, readable scientific objects, and no fabricated pixels. Reject internal workflow/provenance/QA/source-bundle language in audience-facing slides. The top-level package decision is not enough; provide item-level decisions and observations for all pages and both contact sheets, and separately judge whether each deck reaches a mature doctoral group-meeting paper-talk bar.
source_contracts: Both papers are real public holdouts and are not presentation reference/gold tuning sources per holdout_eligibility.json.
The source bundles were frozen before successful production rendering and are bound by SHA256.
No manual generated TeX/PDF/PNG edit, production code change, or post-render source-bundle rewrite was applied.
Local visual QA already observed possible blockers; Terra should judge rendered pixels directly and independently.

non_blocking_notes: Both decks use a consistent CUHK purple header/footer treatment and have visually coherent paper-talk sequencing.
The reviewed pixels show article figures and medical/scientific imagery; pixel inspection alone cannot establish provenance or determine whether any unobserved imagery was fabricated.
Neither deck should be accepted as mature until the blocking audience-language, scale, and collision defects are corrected.
